kind: pre-freeze purpose-preservation review of 15 actual case-read journeys
method: Offline pure presenter applied to existing v6 actual receipts; no model requests, no new CRM calls, no source edits. This is a design/purpose comparison, not a v7 regression score.

categories.category: Closed record has no resolution reason; user also wants to reflect unresolved situation
categories.behavior: Show actual fields, explicitly state reason/work evidence is absent, clarify whether the returned candidate is the intended issue, and preserve choice between a new physical request and a separate public complaint.
Keep every relevant candidate and readable dates/descriptions, then ask which. A prior detail call alone must not erase candidates or decide the user intent.

categories.category: Requested reference missing from own history
categories.behavior: State the requested reference was not returned; showing unrelated owned rows is not an answer by itself. Do not assert another owner exists.
Explain own-account visibility and lack of authorized details. A table of the current account cannot substitute for the access boundary answer.

categories.category: Request to reopen or change state
categories.behavior: Explain unavailable capability, no mutation occurred, and optional distinct public follow-up choices. Returning a status table alone is not sufficient.

categories.category: Request for file retrieval without a usable attachment reference/content
categories.behavior: Distinguish attachment marker from actual locator/content; explain why retrieval was not possible and do not fabricate a download or official-channel synchronization.

recommendation: Render factual record fields on the host; separately render structured conversational outcome/next-action enums selected by the primary planner and validated against evidence/capability policy. Avoid replacing the complete response based solely on the presence of a read receipt. Normal pendingInput bypass does not preserve natural clarification currently returned through finish.
additional_field_issue: The inspected presenter date aliases omit the actual fixture field CreatedAt. Preserve returned dates so natural choices by week/date remain possible; do not invent dates when absent.
